top_maker_positive_b2.interpretation: If incomplete maker execution ultimately realizes the observed taker fallback economics, full-bundle maker completion must exceed 86.7451% to break even. Under the deliberately hypothetical IID equal-leg-fill approximation, an eight-leg bundle would need about 98.2383% fill probability per leg. Real fills are dependent, so the per-leg figure is a hurdle diagnostic rather than an estimator.

research_conclusion.material_change: The current live frontier contains a maker-positive B2 candidate for the first time in the refreshed sample, but its economics are dominated by execution completion risk.
research_conclusion.reason: No B2 production intent was admitted, the direct B2 forward probe remains absent from current main, and the observed maker-vs-taker edge wedge implies an 86.75% full-bundle completion hurdle for an eight-leg bundle. Direct event-time B2 completion and fill-conditioned markout evidence is required.
research_conclusion.next_measurement: Run the direct B2 forward replay on this exact eight-leg candidate with causal pre-arrival microprice/depth/imbalance/OFI, queue stress, partial/full completion, forced-completion loss, and 60s/300s fill-conditioned markout.
